import Mathlib.RingTheory.Localization.Integer
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Localization.FractionRing
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.GaussLemma
#check_failure Roth.RSet
namespace RSet179Isolated
open MvPolynomial
#check MvPolynomial.restrictSupport
#check MvPolynomial.mem_restrictSupport_iff
#check MvPolynomial.basisRestrictSupport
#check MvPolynomial.restrictSupport_add
#check MvPolynomial.mem_restrictDegree
#check MvPolynomial.degreeOf_le_iff
theorem degree_support_bridge {σ : Type*} {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R]
    (P : MvPolynomial σ R) (r : σ → ℕ) :
    (∀ j, degreeOf j P ≤ r j) ↔
      P ∈ MvPolynomial.restrictSupport R {d | ∀ j, d j ≤ r j} := by
  simp only [MvPolynomial.mem_restrictSupport_iff, Set.subset_def, Finset.mem_coe,
    MvPolynomial.degreeOf_le_iff]
  exact ⟨fun h d hd j ↦ h j d hd, fun h j d hd ↦ h d hd j⟩
#print axioms degree_support_bridge
end RSet179Isolated

MvPolynomial.restrictSupport.{u, v} {σ : Type u} (R : Type v) [CommSemiring R] (s : Set (σ →₀ ℕ)) :
  Submodule R (MvPolynomial σ R)

MvPolynomial.mem_restrictSupport_iff.{u, v} {σ : Type u} (R : Type v) [CommSemiring R] {s : Set (σ →₀ ℕ)}
  {r : MvPolynomial σ R} : r ∈ restrictSupport R s ↔ ↑r.support ⊆ s

MvPolynomial.basisRestrictSupport.{u, v} {σ : Type u} (R : Type v) [CommSemiring R] (s : Set (σ →₀ ℕ)) :
  Module.Basis (↑s) R ↥(restrictSupport R s)

MvPolynomial.restrictSupport_add.{u, v} {σ : Type u} (R : Type v) [CommSemiring R] (s t : Set (σ →₀ ℕ)) :
  restrictSupport R (s + t) = restrictSupport R s * restrictSupport R t

MvPolynomial.mem_restrictDegree.{u, v} (σ : Type u) {R : Type v} [CommSemiring R] (p : MvPolynomial σ R) (n : ℕ) :
  p ∈ restrictDegree σ R n ↔ ∀ s ∈ p.support, ∀ (i : σ), s i ≤ n

MvPolynomial.degreeOf_le_iff.{u, u_1} {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] {n : σ} {f : MvPolynomial σ R}
  {d : ℕ} : degreeOf n f ≤ d ↔ ∀ m ∈ f.support, m n ≤ d
